name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers

fit.note: 535 cal within 400-650; 9g carbs well under 35g; no seafood; oven-baked stuffed peppers weigh-and-divide to 14. Fat is heavy (44g) but calories still sit mid-band.

dupe_check.reason: Shares the philly flavor family with philly-cheesesteak-skillet-bowls (Ground Beef Philly Cheesesteak Bowls) but differs on 3 of 4 axes: protein (shaved steak vs 93-7 ground beef), starch (bell-pepper vessel, no starch vs rice), and method (oven-baked stuffed pepper vs skillet rice bowl). Only the provolone/onion/mushroom flavor profile overlaps. Distinct from unstuffed-pepper-skillet-bowls, which is a tomato-sauce Italian ground-beef skillet, not a cheesesteak. No stuffed-pepper cheesesteak exists in the beef catalog.

cross_protein_collisions: A chicken or turkey 'philly cheesesteak stuffed peppers' would be the same construction (steak/meat + onion + mushroom + provolone baked in a pepper half) with the protein swapped - decider should check chicken/turkey/pork pools for a stuffed-pepper cheesesteak twin.
Also watch for any 'stuffed peppers' in another protein sharing the pepper-vessel + cheese format even under a different flavor.
